mapper.insert: INSERT INTO import_failures (entry_name, transaction_date, attempts, last_error, last_attempted_at) VALUES (#{entryName}, #{transactionDate}, 1, #{lastError}, now()) ON CONFLICT (entry_name, transaction_date) DO UPDATE SET attempts = import_failures.attempts + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, last_attempted_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT attempts FROM import_failures WHERE entry_name = #{entryName} AND transaction_date = #{transactionDate}), 0 )
